name: IBUPROFEN / CAFFEINE 400/100 MG 10 CAPS BRYSBAL
description: The combination of ibuprofen and caffeine in 400/100 mg capsules is an analgesic and anti-inflammatory used to treat more intense pain, such as migraines, headaches, menstrual cramps, and muscle aches. Ibuprofen relieves pain and inflammation, while caffeine enhances their effects. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
